:::{#def-logical-entailment}
#### Logical entailment, logical consequence, deductive consequence

Propositions or predicates $\dsn{P}$
(@def-proposition, @def-predicate)
**logically entail**
[@wikipedia_logical_consequence]
a proposition or predicate $Q$
when every choice of values for their variables
that makes all of $\dsn{P}$ true
also makes $Q$ true.
Then $Q$ is a **logical consequence**, or **deductive consequence**,
of $\dsn{P}$.

:::
